title: Asclepius: An Adaptive Harness for Long-Horizon Clinical Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are predominantly benchmarked on short, single-task trajectories, yet real deployments run for hours under contention, surfacing a different class of failures. We use the Clinical Environment Simulator (CES), in which an agent manages an entire emergency-department shift under continuous time and resource pressure, as a testbed: long-horizon execution failures manifest measurably in a single rollout under structured, multi-dimensional grading. On CES, current agents reach the correct diagnosis in most cases yet fail to deliver complete and timely critical actions, revealing an execution gap. We attribute this gap to three long-horizon failure modes, each operationalized as a per-trace counter: instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness, and a severity-equity gap in timeliness. translated_title: Asclepius：面向长时程临床智能体的自适应执行框架
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通常在短小的单任务轨迹上进行基准测试，然而实际部署往往需要在资源竞争下连续运行数小时，从而暴露出另一类失效问题。我们采用临床环境模拟器（CES）作为测试平台——在该环境中，智能体需要在持续的时间和资源压力下管理整个急诊科的轮班：在结构化、多维度的评分体系下，长时程执行失败能够在单次轨迹中得到可度量的体现。在CES上，当前智能体在大多数情况下能够得出正确的诊断，却无法完整、及时地执行关键处置动作，从而暴露出一个“执行鸿沟”。我们将这一鸿沟归因于三种长时程失效模式，并将每种模式操作化为针对单条轨迹的计数器：指令依从性漂移、治疗不完整性，以及及时性上的严重程度公平性差距。随后，我们提出了Asclepius，一种具备自我演化框架的自适应智能体支架，它会在各轮班之间重写操作手册……
tldr: 该论文提出临床环境模拟器CES与自适应智能体支架Asclepius，揭示了LLM智能体在长时程急诊轮班任务中虽诊断正确却存在执行鸿沟（指令漂移、治疗不完整、重症处置不及时），并通过在轮班间自我演化重写操作手册来提升长时程执行能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Clinical Environment Simulator (CES) and Asclepius, an adaptive scaffolding with a self-evolving harness that rewrites its operating manual between shifts to close the execution gap where LLM agents diagnose correctly but fail at complete and timely critical actions in long-horizon emergency-department tasks.
